articles.title: In Lebanon, the opening of a second airport reflects political shifts
articles.description: By Laila Bassam and Nazih OsseiranKLEIAT AIRPORT, Lebanon, Nov 25 (Reuters) - Lebanon plans to open a second international airport next month to bring economic growth to the poorer north, in a project that underlines the diminished political sway of the Hezbollah group, which had long opposed it.Kleiat Airport, located on the Mediterranean coast, about 20 km (12 miles) from the border crossing to Syria, will offer another gateway to Lebanon alongside Beirut international airport, where travel has been disrupted by wars between Israel and Hezbollah in recent years.
